---
title: "RFC 006: Serve Command Family"
subtitle: "List, Validate, Deploy for Serve Workspace Governance"
date: 2026-01-18
---

## Executive Summary

This RFC implements the additional `autocleaneeg-pipeline serve` commands required by RFC 002: `list`, `validate`, and `deploy`. The commands surface workspace status, validate operator-edited YAMLs, and promote configurations into a read-only deployed set under `deploy/` after successful validation.

## Command Overview

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `serve list` | Report workspace path, YAML status, runtime folders, and automation directories. |
| `serve validate --mode <test|live>` | Validate the operator YAML for structure, paths, and mode alignment. |
| `serve deploy --mode <test|live>` | Copy validated YAML into `deploy/` and mark it read-only. |

: Table 1. Serve command family additions.

## Deployment Guardrails

- Operator YAMLs (`serve-test.yaml`, `serve-live.yaml`) remain editable.
- Deployed YAMLs live in `deploy/` and are marked read-only after deployment.
- Validation checks required keys, runtime paths, automation root paths, and mode alignment.

## Validation Steps

```bash
uv run python -m autoclean.cli serve list --path "/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace"
uv run python -m autoclean.cli serve validate --mode test --path "/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace"
uv run python -m autoclean.cli serve deploy --mode test --path "/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace"
```

Result: `serve list` reported expected workspace components and missing deployed YAMLs. `serve validate --mode test` succeeded with warnings for empty `taskfile`/`montage`. `serve deploy --mode test` created `deploy/serve-test.yaml`, marked it read-only, and preserved the warnings for incomplete operator fields.
